title: In multiple functions of SaveUi.java, there is a possible bypass of package installation requirements… (CVE-2026-45514)
description: CVE-2026-45514 is a logic error vulnerability in multiple functions of SaveUi.java that allows bypassing package installation requirements. This flaw enables local privilege escalation without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 8.4.
